variant.author: MaryUsagi
variant.changelog:
**Fixes**
- Fixed DTR bar not immediately updating on setting change
- Fixed some lyrics in the past being displayed when they shouldn't be
- Fixed some song starts not having a music line inserted
- Fixed songs with long instrumental sections cause errors with 0-1 ahead lyrics set
**Added**
- Add an option to have lyrics show up on the DTR bar before they play, with how long in advance being configurable (default 0.75s)
- Make window not grab focus on appear
- Slight change to tooltip on DTR entry
variant.description:
Allows you to use keyboard shortcuts in the HUD Layout Editor, like Ctrl+C and Ctrl+V to copy and paste the position of individual HUD elements, and Ctrl+Z and Ctrl+Y to undo and redo changes. 

Can also display an overlay showing alignment to other elements with Ctrl+R.
variant.name: HUD Layout Helper
variant.punchline: Adds QoL features to the native HUD layout editor: Undo, Redo, Copy, Paste and alignment lines.
